reading.title: Freedom and responsibility
reading.content: Philosophers have long argued that freedom cannot exist without responsibility. A person who acts without considering consequences is not truly free but merely impulsive. Society grants us certain liberties on the assumption that we will act with reason and consideration for others. True freedom, therefore, is as much about restraint as it is about choice.
reading.translationUz: Faylasuflar uzoq vaqtdan beri erkinlik mas’uliyatsiz mavjud bo‘la olmasligini ta’kidlab kelishgan. Oqibatlarni o‘ylamay harakat qiladigan odam haqiqatda erkin emas, balki shunchaki shaxsidir. Jamiyat bizga ma’lum huquqlarni oqilona va boshqalarni hisobga olgan holda harakat qilishimiz asosida beradi. Shuning uchun chinakam erkinlik tanlov qanchalik muhim bo‘lsa, o‘zini tiya olish ham shunchalik muhimdir.

reading.title: The ethics of technology
reading.content: As artificial intelligence becomes more capable, questions about responsibility grow more urgent. If an autonomous system causes harm, is the fault with the developer, the company that deployed it, or the user who approved its action? Current regulations rarely answer this clearly. Philosophers argue that any system entrusted with real-world decisions should also come with transparent accountability for its outcomes.
reading.translationUz: Sun'iy intellekt yanada kuchliroq bo‘lgani sari, javobgarlik haqidagi savollar yanada dolzarb bo‘lmoqda. Agar avtonom tizim zarar yetkazsa, aybdor ishlab chiquvchimi, uni joriy etgan kompaniyami yoki uning harakatini tasdiqlagan foydalanuvchimi? Hozirgi qoidalar bunga aniq javob bermaydi. Faylasuflarning fikriga ko‘ra, haqiqiy dunyo qarorlarini qabul qilishga ishonib topshirilgan har qanday tizim o‘z natijalari uchun shaffof hisobdorlikka ega bo‘lishi kerak.

reading.title: The nature of knowledge
reading.content: Epistemology asks what we can know and how we can justify our beliefs. Some philosophers argue that only propositions supported by empirical evidence count as knowledge, while others reserve a place for intuition and reason. These debates have practical consequences for science, law, and even everyday arguments.
reading.translationUz: Epistemologiya biz nimani bila olishimiz va e'tiqodlarimizni qanday asoslashimiz haqida so‘raydi. Ba'zi faylasuflar faqat empirik dalillar bilan tasdiqlangan tushunchalarni bilim deb hisoblaydi, boshqalari esa intuitsiya va aqlga o‘rin qoldiradi. Bu bahslar fan, huquq va hatto kundalik tortishuvlar uchun amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

reading.title: The free market debate
reading.content: Classical economists argue that markets, left alone, allocate resources efficiently through the price signal. Critics counter that unregulated markets concentrate wealth, ignore externalities like pollution, and underfund public goods. Modern economies tend to blend market mechanisms with targeted regulation to balance efficiency and fairness.
reading.translationUz: Klassik iqtisodchilar bozorlar o‘zini o‘zi boshqarsa, narx signali orqali resurslarni samarali taqsimlashini aytadi. Tanqidchilar esa tartibga solinmagan bozorlar boylikni to‘plashini, ifloslanish kabi tashqi omillarni e'tiborsiz qoldirishini va jamoat ne'matlarini kam moliyalashtirishini qayd etadi. Zamonaviy iqtisodiyotlar samaradorlik va adolat o‘rtasida muvozanat uchun bozor mexanizmlarini maqsadli tartibga solish bilan birlashtirishga intiladi.

reading.title: Why history matters
reading.content: History is more than a record of past events — it is a tool for making sense of the present. Understanding how a conflict began, or why an institution was created, often changes how we evaluate current proposals. Societies that forget their history tend to repeat the same mistakes with slightly different vocabulary.
reading.translationUz: Tarix o‘tgan voqealar yozuvidan ko‘ra ko‘proq narsa — bu bugungi kunni tushunish uchun vosita. Nizo qanday boshlanganini yoki muassasa nega yaratilganini tushunish ko‘pincha hozirgi takliflarni qanday baholashimizni o‘zgartiradi. Tarixini unutgan jamiyatlar bir xil xatolarni biroz boshqa so‘zlar bilan takrorlashga moyil.
